strengths: Strong full-stack engineering background across multiple languages and domains
Proven open-source leadership with GISCollective and developer tooling
Active knowledge sharer with workshops and public talks on technical topics
concerns: No evidence of 15 years focused on AI, cloud, or infrastructure engineering
Lacks demonstrable AI product or platform development experience
No indication of director-level strategic influence or customer advisory roles
